ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant, low-intensity black region occupies the central fluke area and peduncle connection. High-intensity white fields are localized on the distal third of both lobes, featuring dense black mottling and micro-speckling, particularly prominent on the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated 60-degree internal angle and a depth of approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. The left lobe exhibits 4-5 high-amplitude peaks, while the right lobe displays a more consistent, low-amplitude sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete white circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) are visible as high-contrast points against the dark central pigmentation on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark curvilinear mark approximately 120 pixels in length is visible on the distal white portion of the left lobe, cutting vertically through the pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margin of the left lobe, creating a significant multi-colored (brown/white/grey) protrusion that disrupts the natural fluke contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant calcified barnacle clusters localized exclusively on the far left tip, presenting a highly unique structural modification to the lobe edge.
